text: Sorry for the essay, I've been up since 4 yesterday morning and my head is all over the place. I'm looking after my grandson tonight so my daughter can get some sleep, she had a rough time with the birth and she's only just home. He's 1 month old, a little boy, born on his due date so not early or anything. I took his temperature about twenty minutes ago because he felt warmer than usual when I picked him up and it said 38.8. I did it again to make sure and it was the same. When I was changing him I noticed some spots on his chest and a few on his legs, tiny little dots like someone pricked him with a pin, and one or two darker bits, more purple, almost like a small bruise. I remembered from when my own were little that you press a glass on it, so I got one from the cupboard and pressed it on and they're all still there, they didn't go pale at all. I don't want to wake my daughter for nothing but I also don't want to sit here if this is something. I've written down the times and the numbers in case you need them. Please tell me what to do, I'm too tired to trust myself
